Visit during spring or fall for beautiful scenery! The trails and boardwalk are all very easy to walk. Arrive early to avoid crowds and spend the whole day exploring.

Jiuzhaigou is so beautiful. Picture perfect at every corner. 1 day is not enough. Do not rush through or take the bus all the time. Walk to some of the attractions. Along the way you will see more and enjoy the sceneries.

Lost in the colors of Jiuzhaigou (despite winter) Crystal-clear lakes, waterfalls, and snow-dusted peaks come together like a real-life painting. Every season feels magical here, but the calm reflections and fresh mountain air make it unforgettable. Nature at its finest. 🍃🏔️ Must not miss this place from your travel plan to China

Definitely book in advance because they do have a daily visitors cap and also consider a hotel within walking distance because the traffic is terrible around the one and only entrance. You will certainly need a full day of 8+ hours to fully explore the entire area's 3 different valleys but definitely a worthwhile experience, the colours are even more spectacular when the sun shines.

Magnificent and exquisite. In comparison to other 5A tourist sites, as graded by the Chinese government, Jiuzhaigou seems to be better preserved, calmer, and rewards the visitor with way more unpolluted natural beauty. It's really worth the effort and you simply wouldn't regret coming here. It's possible to do it in one day if you don't mind hurrying through photo ops, but if you're one who likes to linger and take it all in and also visit all the pretty spots then 2 days are recommended. You can get on and off the shuttle but it also pays to walk between some of the stops so a bit of planning won't hurt.

Jiuzhaigou is truly a must-visit destination and leaves a lasting impression on anyone who goes there. The scenery is unforgettable, with every turn offering breathtaking views. The highlight is definitely the stunning blue river, which looks almost unreal with its crystal-clear waters. It flows gracefully through the landscape, blending beautifully with the surrounding mountains and lush green fields. The contrast of colors creates a picture-perfect scene that feels like a painting come to life. Walking along the paths and taking in the natural beauty makes the whole experience peaceful and memorable. Jiuzhaigou is a place you will never forget。

One of the premier national parks in china. So here’s what you need to know. You can and should finish the entire park in a day. There are two main spots, 五花海 which has a very specific area to take photos and 五彩池。Everything else in the park is pretty similar and not a lot less impressive.

I absolutely had the best experience in Jiuzhaigou. It was very crowded when I visited; however, the park was extremely well organized, with plenty of buses to transport visitors around. The views were breathtaking—something I truly can’t describe in words.

熊猫海 is a distinctive mountain lake in 九寨沟’s Rize Valley, named for once being a favorite drinking and foraging spot for giant pandas along with a panda-patterned white stone lying under its water. 熊猫海 is one of 九寨沟 few lakes that freezes in winter, with obvious seasonal water level swings up to 5-7 meters, and it feeds the park’s tallest 熊猫海 Waterfall during the high water period. Its water keeps a calm and clear turquoise shade all year round, shifting softly with the change of sunlight and seasons. The lake’s unique color and remarkable clarity come from natural factors without any filters. Karst calcite deposits in the water reflect blue-green light, while ultra-clear and low-turbidity water absorbs long red and orange light waves. Submerged trees and algae add subtle depth to the water color, and the annual freeze-thaw cycle plus water level changes polish the lake bed’s calcite layers continuously over time. It is a quiet and characterful spot in this UNESCO World Heritage Site, ideal for nature lovers who enjoy observing subtle shifts and changes in the natural landscape.

Breathtaking scenic, must visit, very crowded. There are internal shuttle buses between lakes.
One word: beautiful Recommendation: trekking shoes with soft insole because lots of walking (I was on a tour and it already took > 20km), at least a full day of visiting.

Our visit to this World Heritage place after visiting Huanglong, and it definitely is the prettier and more unique of the two 👍🏻 That said, the rowdiness of the crowd when it comes to queueing at the park entrance to the shuttle bus is horrifying. ⏰ timeline as follows: 0655 reach 0730 clear queue 0815 reach long lake peak (random of the two peaks) 0935 reach bamboo lake (to transit to the forest peak) 0955 reach forest peak 1105 reach swan lake shuttle 1200 reach centre 1330 reach waterfall shuttle 1400 reach base camp 🌊 first of the few categories of scenic spots were its famous blue/green water lakes/sea - which was very pretty at first sight, since we were brought to one of the deepest lakes (90m deep) at 3000m above sea level 💦 the waterfall were the other category, and we visited the one nearest to the centre of the camp since that’s the nicest of the few available 🌲 the forest peak is alright, not something that can’t be found outside of the park In general, the vibes and majestic mountains played a big part in the entire atmosphere, the most memorable one being the swan lake where we walked into a treeless mountain, and blue lake and a pine tree mountain too. That said, I wouldn’t visit more than 2 of the same categories as they can get repetitive - would advise to stay at unique places for longer to soak in the beauty of the view instead of chasing all the sights.

Jiuzhaigou Nature Reserve covers more than 700 km² of valleys, turquoise lakes, and waterfalls at 2,000–3,000 m elevation, so plan at least a full day. Purchase tickets online in advance and arrive early at the main gate to clear security and board the green eco-buses—these are the only vehicles allowed inside. Buses operate like a hop-on, hop-off system: show your ticket each time you re-board and get off at clearly marked stops near each scenic area. Begin with the upper valleys (Rize and Zechawa) and work downward to Shuzheng to conserve energy and follow the natural flow of attractions. Must-see highlights include Five Flower Lake with its kaleidoscope of colors, Nuorilang Waterfall (one of China’s widest), Pearl Shoal and Pearl Shoal Waterfall, Mirror Lake for morning reflections, and the remote Long Lake at the valley’s top. Tibetan villages along the way offer cultural displays and handicrafts. Food options are limited to several service centers near major junctions, serving simple buffet meals, noodles, and drinks—bring snacks and water for flexibility. Walking boardwalks connect bus stops to viewpoints; allow time for leisurely strolls and photos. Dress in layers, wear sturdy shoes, pace yourself at altitude, and stay on marked paths to protect the fragile ecosystem.

Went there in March; the Long Lake was still covered with snow. The weather was nice. We spent a day there and visited Mirror Lake, Peacock Lake, Panda Lake, Pearl Shoal Waterfall, Long Lake, Five Flower Lake, Rhinoceros Lake, and Tibetan villages. The pork sausage dipped in Maya chili was delicious, and it cost 10 yuan. Once in a lifetime—gotta visit there!

One of the rare destination in China that truly live up to its hype. Its a captivating blend of blue water pond, alpine-like mountainous backdrop and flowing warerfall. Definitely worth a visit once in a lifetime. Autumn is highly recommended as it added the vibrant colour to the scenery. However, note that you will see the most amount of human crowding into a single place like you never see before. So be prepared to get pushed around to get on the bus. The park is however very big so you can generally find a decent photo spot with a very few exceptions.

I visited on March 25, 2025, and noticed that most of the snow had already melted, leaving only a thin layer on the mountain peaks. The trees were still bare, with no signs of greenery, and some of the ponds had dried up. Given these conditions, I feel that this might not be the best time to visit. I believe that visiting during the autumn foliage season would be much more breathtaking. The number of visitors was relatively low, making the experience peaceful. The park also has food and drinks available for purchase. Overall, I wasn’t as impressed as I had hoped, likely due to the timing of my visit. However, I still think it’s a place worth visiting at least once. The park’s management is outstanding—everything is clean, well-organized, and efficiently run.

Jiuzhai valley is a National Park located in Sichuan province in southwest of China. It’s very famous for its water. The park is so big that it’s impossible to visit the main sites on foot, you would have to either take public transport or a VIP van. It said that during peak times, it can have more than 40k visitors each day. Suggest join a group with a guy so that you can see the major attractions within a day.

Some truly amazing and spectacular once-in-a-lifetime scenes. Worth the visit, in spite of crowds, it is something you need to see in front of your own eyes and experience for yourself. The beauty is breathtaking. We visited in winter, which is off peak. We did not see as many colours as one would in autumn or spring, but it was spectacular to see snow on the mountains and also parts of the waterfalls frozen. It is really quite amazing.
Amazing national park , nice and well manage to handle crowded people , queue for bus is fast , toilet all over the stop

Our tour to Jiuzhaigou scenic attractions, we started from a local train ride from Chengdu to Songpan station. Weather was cold indeed and there were many local tourists. We boarded a chartered bus after the entrance and we stopped at some scenic lakes for taking photos on those beautiful sceneries. Water in those lakes was crystal clear and our tour leader informed us that this place was well reserved by the local authorities. There are local peoples settled around mountains and houses / temples are built according to Tibetan traditions - colourful exterior indeed. We took our lunch midway at a local restaurant serving buffet style. Lunch is filling and we took the opportunity to fill up some hot water in our bottles. There are shops selling local souvenirs and beautiful costumes, we bought some beaded bracelets and hats. As we continued our scenic walks, we spoke to local people who are polite and smile gracefully though we couldn’t understand their local dialect well. It’s really a super nice and good tourist attraction that should not be missed, weather was still cold in March.

Jiuzhai Valley National Park offers spectacular beautiful views and a soothing environment that truly refreshes the soul. You will not regret the time spent there or the effort to reach this stunning destination (it's pretty far away from Chengdu and it makes for a day trip with night stay nearby). I was part of a tour during my visit in May, which made the experience smoother. Although it was an off-peak period, the park was still slightly crowded. The tour included pre-booked transportation, which was a great convenience since public transport (within the park) often requires lining up. While the rain during my visit made it a bit inconvenient, the waters were still crystal clear with a brilliantly rich blue/cyan tint from the calcium minerals, justaposed against the emerald green of the forest and the white, dreamy clouds. The pictures don't do it justice (as much as they look edited), and you'll feel like you're in a dreamland. I particularly enjoyed the 五花海 and 老虎嘴 viewpoints, which I felt had the best blend of water, mountains and foliage.

Words can't describe how beautiful this place is. 10/10. Highly recommend to book private bus as this place is huge and you wouldn't want to squeeze in with the sea of people in the local bus. Will definitely visit again in the autumn to see the different coloured leaves, as recommended by our travel agency tour guide.

Pictures alone can't portray the beauty of this place! There are some amazingly beautiful and scenic spots all throughout the Jiuzhai Valley National Park where ever which way you turn, it's like a national geographic postcard. The waters ranged from almost sapphire blue to torquoise to deep acqua. The National Park had so many spots to visit, you could spend a whole day or two to really see it properly and stop at every site. We went in late April but the locals said each season has its unique beauty so one should come visit at least once each of the four seasons 😅 I personally think over autumn, it would be magical, the contrast of the water again the many autumn hues of the trees...... just like being in a magical fairytale ✨️ The beauty of the landscape and sites again though, the National Park is incredibly busy with lots and lots of tourists all with varying levels of politeness. There were some lovely people offering up their seats on buses to those in greater need but equally there were really rude individuals who kept pushing from behind in lines and on buses 💀 the good thing about building so much infrastructure like roads and buses in the park is accessibility for everyone but equally the bad thing is it's accessible for everyone. The locals said during peak times there would be tourists in the 50-60 thousand a day to pass through in one day, which seems like a lot even if the Park is quite big! If you can handle the people then the site is definitely worth a visit! One of a kind and not something you can see anywhere else in the world!

Went on a week day 5/11/24, surprisingly not as many tourists as I expected, luckily I didn’t book the private car which cost around ¥300-500per person! We got on and off the public bus easily with seat available. So wise to avoid the weekends to visit.

Visit Jiuzhaigou in early Dec 24 . Winter is off-season to travel, so the entrance fee is cheaper than the peak season . Enjoyed the natural beauty of winter . Suddenly felt the winter sun is so warm . Natural scenery is so beautiful that it made me fall in love with this place .

Eventhough we left Hilton Garden Inn Jiuzhaigou for Jiuzhai Valley National Park at 8am sharp, we realised that we were actually quite late to the party! There was already no available parking lots for the buses and we had to park a distance away. After alighting, our guide had to get us into taxis (20RMB per taxi) to bring us to the entrance, instead of walking 20 minutes. To save cost, we did see many groups making this 20 minutes walk. Everyone was rushing towards the entrance of the park as though the park was giving away some freebie! After reaching the actual entrance, it was another queue for us to scan our tickets. As our guide had our tickets tagged to our passport, we just had to enter our passport number at the gate. The tickets was 90RMB for adults and we saw on the screen of one of our travel mates that entry was free for those above 70 years old. During our wait, it started to drizzle rather heavily. Hence, it is also important to always prepare your umbrellas or rain coats for entry to Jiuzhaigou National Park! For more details, visit 2bearbear today!
Very nice, the water is especially blue due to the minerals. I heard that autumn is very beautiful, I will come back.

Jiuzhai Valley National Park is absolutely stunning! The park’s crystal-clear turquoise lakes, multi-tiered waterfalls, and vibrant forests create a picturesque landscape straight out of a fairy tale. The well-preserved natural beauty and rich biodiversity make it a paradise for nature enthusiasts and photographers alike. A must-visit destination for anyone exploring the beauty of China’s natural wonders. Highly recommend!

UNESCO world heritage site that needs not much introduction. There is a new bullet train station called Huanglongjiuzhai, which would bring you much closer to this park. It would still take about 1.5 hours to 2 hours to get here, so definitely recommended to stay at a location near to this place and then dedicate a full day for this. First of all, the park is huge and most likely you would not be able to see all of the lakes. But there are a couple of must go spots which are the most spectacular or beautiful. Due to the number of tourists daily, the park has defined processes so it is rather easy to navigate the park. For example, upon entering the park, the bus that we boarded brought us to long lake, which is at the 1 end of the park. If we would have board another bus, we may have ended at the other end of the park. Generally, the idea is to start from one end of the park and travel towards the mid point when the 2 valleys intersect, then head to the other end and go from there. It is almost impossible to walk the entire park, but there would be prominent points where you are encouraged the board the bus to narrow the walking distance to the next lake/spot. The restaurant/food are only at Nuorilang centre, while there are other snacks at the various spots around the park. Note the pass is only for a single day visit so if you plan to do 2 days to explore the park, you will need to buy entrance ticket for each day. There are also plenty of toilets within the park.

One of the most astounding and breathtaking attractions in China and in the world. Stunning must-see for natural scenery lovers. Jiuzhaigou is renowned for its rolling mountains, dense forests, colorful lakes, steep waterfalls, and wide variety of birds and animals.

A nationalpark with many different lakes. The green/blue color will be different depending on the sunshine (may not be present when raining). The park is a little bit crouded therefore better come around 8:00. When going in the bus would not tell you if they go left or right (basically a blind box). If possible choose a seat on the left side (better until middle and the left area). The park has hot water in the middle if you want to bring ramen. Generally worth a trip when you visit Chengdu (as they have a highspeed train) and in combination with the Huanglong park (take care of height). Tickets should be reserved (may require wechat).

Breathtakingly beautiful! I was amazed by the vibrant colours of each lake. Turquoise, crystal blue, amber… my photos probably didn’t capture its beauty well. It’s a place worth visiting at least once in a lifetime! However, the route to Jiuzhai Valley National Park from Chengdu took 7-10 hours depending on traffic conditions. Be prepared for long rides.
One of the most wonderful place in Sichuan. I miss Jiuzhaigou so much, and really want to come back to visit this majestic national park⭐️

A must-visit, once-in-a-lifetime destination in Sichuan, China, famous for its colorful lakes, waterfalls, and stunning natural beauty. You can take a high-speed train from Chengdu to Songpan Station, then a taxi or bus to your hotel nearby. To fully enjoy the valley's breathtaking scenery, it’s recommended to spend two days exploring the area. Despite the crowds, especially on holidays, the beauty of Jiuzhai Valley makes it an unforgettable experience for any traveller.

Lakes, waterfalls,calcsinter beach flow -karst landform of Jiuzhagou is rare in the world. It performed different scenarios in all seasons. Worth to visit. Preferably during spring autumn and winter.

Hello, Have you ever imagined a dreamlike valley with waters shimmering in blue, green and golden colors, where mountains, lakes and waterfalls are spreading a majestic beauty? One such valley is called Jiuzhaigou. Located in Sichuan Province, China, about 330 kilometers from Chengdu, this magical valley is included in the UNESCO World Heritage List and is famous all over the world for its natural beauty. The clear lakes, high waterfalls and colorful ponds here make this valley a paradise. Last weekend, we traveled to this beautiful valley of Jiuzhaigou. On Friday, we left Chengdu in the afternoon after work and spent the night in a comfortable hotel in Jiuzhaigou. The next day, when we started our journey through this dreamlike valley, we felt as if we had entered a majestic fairy tale. First we arrived at Long Lake, and as soon as we got there, we felt like we were in a television documentary or an animated world. The morning snowfall had covered the trees with a white blanket, and the snow-covered trees in the background of the lake were creating a magical scene. It was all incredible, but the cold there was so intense that we shivered. After that, we headed to the 5 Colored Pond. This lake is a natural wonder of Jiuzhaigou, whose water shimmers in five different colors. The water of the lake is so clear that blue, green, yellow, and purple are reflected in it, which are its special characteristics. It is said that the color of this lake never remains the same and changes depending on the season. Then we arrived at the 5 Flower Lake, where the water is so transparent that the trees and stones below are clearly visible. This lake also has the ability to change its color and spreads new colors with the season. Finally, Nurling Waterfall was also a memorable part of our trip. When we saw this high waterfall, the rapid flow of water took us to another world. The noise of this waterfall and the rapid waves of water are truly captivating. After visiting Jiuzhaigou, we found a Muslim hotel nearby where we had dinner. There were many other halal Muslim restaurants there. No filter needed. This should definitely be in everyone's travel bucket list. The spring time is pleasant with lots of flower. Lake color is impressive. You can smell the freshness of the forest. Very refreshing 💗

Absolutely beautiful national park!! Worth to visit and see wonderful nature with your own eyes👀 However, Bit hard to travel in China as long distance from city so maybe need 4-5 hrs sitting in the bus🚎
What a wonderful natural miracle. The lakes are all in truly unique colors. Colors so intense which makes you believe it is fake. However what a stunning national park.

One of the most beautiful national parks on the planet. Pristine forest cover and several lakes each with a different hue. Accessibility within the park is managed extremely well as there are nice walking trails and tour buses. You need at least 2 days to explore this area.

A masterpiece! Must-go place in Sichuan. Shuttle bus is operated smoothly so you can hope on and off easily. There’re restroom and vending machines at the bus station. Must-visit attraction: Mirror lake, Long Lake, Multicolored Lake and Waterfall of Panda lake. Lots of easy hiking trails are available if you want to stay away from the crowds and shuttle bus. You’d better buy tickets online on Ctrip and come easy to beat the traffics. The bus station at the entrance is extremely crowded around 830-9am (took me 1.5h to wait for the bus). Sunscreen, waterproof jacket and umbrella are strongly recommended as weather can change easily and quickly.
Big place and many attractions inside. Shuttle bus runs around the park, very convenient. Private mini bus also available if you want privacy.

Stunning view in almost all the gou! Try to start your visit via the right to primitive forest and walk down to the central area to have lunch, then go to the left side, which has only 2gou. Finally, back at the central area to slowly walk down to the main entrance. Try bus if distance above 3km between any gou. Important for mirror lake is to go there when sun is out.

Jiuzhaigou is truly like stepping into heaven on earth. Crystal-clear lakes, cascading waterfalls, and snow-capped peaks create a dreamlike landscape. Words can’t capture its magic—you have to be there, breathing in the fresh mountain air, to understand its beauty. This is a place everyone should experience at least once in a lifetime.

Visited Oct 2016. Rated as most beautiful national park in world. Definitely the most beautiful I have seen. Credit to China for well maintained transport system in park and boardwalks throughout, enabling easy getting around for all.

Jiuzhai Valley national park is one of the best natural places in China. It is really breath taking, however, because of the population problem in China, the park is always full of people from all over the country and world. And the entrance fee is about 300 RMB which is around 40 dollars. Each season has its unique scene so that each season is worth your visiting.

Jiuzhaigou, also known as the Fairyland of China, is for sure worth its name. Very beautiful scenic spots and nature at its best. Two full days can be spent there, one full day is enough if you don’t mind rushing. Photos from April 2016. (There was an earthquake, which may be the reason why the landscape doesn’t seem as my photos posted.)

Absolutely. Breathtaking. As one of the top rated 5AAAAA national parks (and the world!), its renown is well deserved. It’s most well known for the crystal clear waters that shine a vibrant turquoise. The park has world class infrastructure with bus routes that run continually. That said, my strong recommendation is to take the scenic walking path meandering through the natural pine forests. If you listen closely you can hear a symphony of bird songs, soaking in the spiritual essence that has cultivated by local Tibetans for centuries. Worth at least a few days to really take it all in. As one of the more established parks, there has been significant investment in building up and supporting the local Tibetans. You can visit some of the local villages (as suggested by its namesake - meaning 9 villages of river valley). All said, one important disclaimer: this is one of the most popular destinations so expect lots of crowds. Best way to avoid crowds is to come during the off seasons.

This is a truly beautiful location worthy a goods few days of visiting. I'm told you really have to see it four times, once for each season but we were there for the freeze. Amazing beauty, but my goodness it was cold. The mist on the water made it seem so much warmer but it wasn't.
Wow what a remarkable place of natural beauty. Great mountain views, and stunning blue waters of the lakes. Truly worth the effort to get there.

The view is nice, but the crowd is bad considered the season was low peak. a lot of views are repetitive, either waterfall or lakes. Have to take a lot of walks inside. The people are very rude, they either bang you from behind or cut your Q. Came here once, and for the last.

A very beautiful park with serene water and majestic mountains. There are so many scenic spots in this park that you need more than a day to explore all of them. There is only one restaurant(canteen) in this park. All the scenic spots are served by the park buses but you may also hike from one to the next.

I must say that Jiuzhaigou is one of the most fabulous sites I have ever been to! The site has a lot to offer, from friendly locals to its breathtaking landscape! One of the best parts of Jiuzhaigou that you must check out when visiting is the Nuorilang Waterfall, which will make you feel like you are dreaming with picturesque scenery in almost every corner! However, I think the stuff there is too costly since it is a tourist spot. Besides, the only way to get there is to drive a private car, which takes around eight hours from Chengdu.
Very Beautiful and good place. One time in the life I recommend every one have to come here.

Regrettably I am just writing a Review for JiuZhaiGou now, because I actually visited this park many years ago. I must say that It is One of the Most Gorgeous Regions on Planet Earth. Located on the Northwestern Corner of Sichuan Province in China, Jiuzhaigou is renowned for its Colorful Foliage; jagged Mountain peaks; numerous Waterfalls and Cascades; as well as many breathtakingly beautiful lakes. Very well managed, the Park offers Tourists with unlimited rides on Buses that run quite frequently among various attractions for a simple Entrance Ticket. I had taken a 3 days tour from Chongqing City, with a full Day in JiuZhai Park, but it was obviously Not enough. Jiuzhai is a photographer's paradise too, as It looks stunning in all seasons! However, you can surely choose your favorite time to visit. Several photos attached as my recommendation.
We were there in early April. Such an unforgettable experience. Everything was so beautiful, clean and well reserved.
First time being here as a Chinese, it’s astonishing though the best season to go is every Oct to Nov. Remarkable
this is definitely one of the most beautiful national park in the world. It will take more than a day to finish all viewing areas.

Exceptional beautiful park. Went 2nd half October 2016 and autumn had not fully coloured the trees. Go early - would recommend 7.30 am as loads of groups come early too. Our group arrived 8 am and it took us 2 hours from the parking to enter the park. Shuttle buses are plenty and saw them lining up for passengers everywhere. As a group one may opt for charter buses at extra cost. But it keeps the group together. Try to figure out what you want to see and direct the charter bus driver as otherwise they stay close to the entrance and probably the most visited spots. For good pictures: do in China as the Chinese do :)
A place that everyone must visit once in a life time. I found no suitable words to describe its beauty. So, let the photos do the talking.

Jiuzhaigou Valley, eulogized as a world of magical fairytale, has for years enchanted tourists with its mountains and luxuriant forests, colorful lakes, gushing waterfalls and abundant wildlife. To its south is the Huanglong (Yellow Dragon Scenic Area). Jiuzhaigou Valley is located in Nanping County, 450 kilometers (about 280 miles) to the north of Chengdu City, Sichuan, covers a total area of 720 square kilometers and the valley is 50 kilometers in length. In 1992, UNESCO entered this scenic area onto the world natural heritage list.Jiuzhaigou, literally the Nine Village Valley, is hence known for the nine Tibetan villages within its boundary, Inhabited by Tibetans, the nine villages and alpine lakes, are like reflecting mirrors or crystal jade blocks inlaid in snow mountains and forests. Very very Amazing natural scenery

Located in the Aba Tibetan Qiang Autonomous Prefecture, in the southwest of China, this natural reserve is included on the UNESCO World Heritage list as well as in its Man and the Biosphere Programme. Autumn is the best time to visit the park, when the forest trees are clad in a full spectrum of colours, contrasting spectacularly with the turquoise lakes. The park is also home to giant pandas, an endangered species.
We came to the only restaurant inside the valley to have our lunch. We went to 2nd floor to have buffet. It’s not bad.

We loved our time at Jiuzhaigou! It was so so beautiful! We recommend going very early in the morning and during low season. We went during summer and it was very crowded. We ended up doing the back way route and it was a lot better, almost no one went that way. Also, bring food, as they only sell instant noodles and snacks inside. 100% recommend!! Jiuzhaigou ([tɕjòu.ʈʂâi.kóu] (￼listen); Chinese: 九寨沟; pinyin: Jiǔzhàigōu) is a nature reserve and national park located in the north of Sichuan Province in southwestern China. A long valley running north to south, Jiuzhaigou was inscribed by UNESCO as a World Heritage Site in 1992 and a World Biosphere Reserve in 1997. It belongs to the category V (Protected Landscape) in the IUCN system of protected area categorization. Quick Facts Jiuzhaigou Valley Scenic and Historic Interest Area 九寨沟风景名胜区, Location ... Quick Facts Chinese name, Simplified Chinese ... One of the famous tourist attraction at JiuZhaiGou Valley--Five Colour Pond The Jiuzhaigou valley is part of the Min Mountains on the edge of the Tibetan Plateau and stretches over 72,000 hectares (180,000 acres). It is known for its many multi-level waterfalls, colorful lakes, and snow-capped peaks. Its elevation ranges from 2,000 to 4,500 metres (6,600 to 14,800 ft). History Jiuzhaigou (literally "Nine Settlement Valley") takes its name from the nine Tibetan settlements along its length. The remote region was inhabited by various Tibetan and Qiang peoples for centuries. Until 1975 this inaccessible area was little known. Extensive logging took place until 1979, when the Chinese government banned such activity and made the area a national park in 1982. An Administration Bureau was established and the site officially opened to tourism in 1984; layout of facilities and regulations were completed in 1987. The site was inscribed by UNESCO as a World Heritage Site in 1992 and a World Biosphere Reserve in 1997. The tourism area is classified as a AAAAA scenic area by the China National Tourism Administration. Since opening, tourist activity has increased every year: from 5,000 in 1984 to 170,000 in 1991, 160,000 in 1995, to 200,000 in 1997, including about 3,000 foreigners. Visitors numbered 1,190,000 in 2002. As of 2004, the site averages 7,000 visits per day, with a quota of 12,000 being reportedly enforced during high season. The Town of Zhangzha at the exit of the valley and the nearby Songpan County feature an ever-increasing number of hotels, including several luxury five-stars, such as Sheraton. Developments related to mass tourism in the region have caused concerns about the impact on the environment around the park.

Jiuzhaigou (Sembilan Lembah Penempatan) mengambil namanya sempena dengan sembilan penempatan Tibet di wilayah itu. Wilayah terpencil itu didiami oleh pelbagai orang Tibet dan Qiang selama berabad-abad. Sehingga tahun 1975 kawasan yang tidak boleh diakses dan kurang diketahui. Pada tahun 2003, penduduk tetap lembah itu adalah kira-kira 1,000 yang terdiri daripada 112 keluarga, dan kerana alam semula jadi taman yang dilindungi, sektor dan aktiviti pertanian tidak lagi dibenarkan jadi penduduk tempatan kini bergantung kepada pelancongan dan subsidi dari kerajaan tempatan untuk mencari rezeki. Tiket masuk : 110yuan/ rm65 Shuttle bas : 90yuan/rm53 Apa je yg ada di JNP? 1. Tasik berwarna warni, cerah dan berubah2 disebabkan kepekatan kalsium karbonat yang tinggi. 2. Air terjun yang banyak. Air terjun Norilang dan Air terjun Mutiara shoal paling luas. 3. Hutan yg subur 4. Puncak gunung yang diliputi salji 5. Taman ini adalah habitat untuk panda gergasi dan species lain yg jarang ditemui. 6. Jiuzhaigou juga menempatkan lebih 220 species burung.

Jiuzhaigou National Park เป็นที่เที่ยวธรรมชาติที่ขึ้นชื่อมากของจีน วันที่ไปบอกตรง ๆ ว่าคนเยอะมาก ทั้งนักท่องเที่ยวจีนและต่างชาติ แต่ถึงอย่างนั้นก็ไม่ได้รู้สึกวุ่นวายเกินไป เพราะอุทยานมีระบบรถรับส่งภายในที่จัดการได้ดี รถมีวิ่งตลอด รอไม่นาน ทำให้การเดินทางระหว่างแต่ละจุดสะดวกกว่าที่คิดไว้เยอะ ความสวยของจิ่วจ้ายโกวคือทะเลสาบสีฟ้า เขียว ใสแจ๋ว มองเห็นพื้นด้านล่างชัดมาก สีของน้ำเปลี่ยนไปตามแสงแดดและมุมที่มอง บางจุดสีสดจนเหมือนใส่ฟิลเตอร์ ทั้งยังมีน้ำตกหลายแห่งที่ไหลลงมาตามแนวหินและป่าไม้ ดูแล้วสดชื่นสุด ๆ เดินไปทางไหนก็เจอวิวสวยตลอดทาง ถึงคนจะเยอะ แต่พอวิวตรงหน้ามันสวยจริง ก็ทำให้ลืมเรื่องคนไปได้เลย เสียดายอย่างเดียวคือเวลาไม่พอ ทำให้ไปไม่ครบทุกจุดตามแผน บางจุดได้แค่ลงไปแป๊บเดียวก็ต้องรีบขึ้นรถต่อ เพราะแต่ละจุดใช้เวลาเดินชมค่อนข้างนาน ถ้าอยากเก็บครบจริง ๆ ควรเผื่อเวลาอย่างน้อยทั้งวัน หรือวางแผนเลือกจุดที่อยากไปมากที่สุดไว้ก่อน โดยรวมแล้ว Jiuzhaigou ยังเป็นสถานที่ที่ควรมาสักครั้งในชีวิต ถึงคนจะเยอะ แต่ระบบจัดการดี ธรรมชาติสวยจริง และคุ้มค่ากับการเดินทางมาก ๆ ใครมีโอกาส แนะนำให้มาแบบไม่รีบ จะได้ซึมซับความสวยได้เต็มที่
ระบบการจัดการในอุทยานดีมาก เจ้าหน้าที่ดี รถสาธารณะดี มีเยอะ ไม่เบียดเสียด ห้องน้ำสะอาด เตรียมร่างกายมาให้พร้อม ยังไงก็รอด เรามาช่วง ต้นตุลาคม 2568 คนเยอะ แต่วิวดีมากๆ ใบไม้กำลังเริ่มเปลี่ยนสี

Một địa điểm được gọi là Thiên đường nơi hạ giới giới với các hồ nước màu xanh ngọc biến đổi các sắc thái xanh khác nhau. Nước hồ trong vắt, xanh mượt mà, không khí trong vắt. Núi đẹp, thác đẹp. Néu tham quan vào tháng 10, khi lá cây chuyển màu vàng rực rỡ chắc là rất rất đẹp và thơ mộng.

Khu du lịch sinh thái khá đẹp. Như Thiên đường nhân gian. Xứng đáng để đi 1 lần trong đời. Có xe buýt nội bộ, tiện lợi để di chuyển. Có lối đi bộ, đi bộ khoảng gần 20 km/ngày, chuẩn bị giày đi bộ, ba lô đựng đồ thiết yếu gọn nhẹ.

九寨溝的美真的超出想像，那種藍綠交錯的湖水、清澈到能映出整片天空的倒影，看起來像是只存在夢裡的場景。五花海、鏡海、長海，每一個都像電腦桌布，現場看比照片還震撼。 景區很大，規劃完善，有觀光車可以搭，走路搭配搭車比較實際。人雖然不少，但路線順暢，不太會覺得擁擠。 雖然門票＋車票價格確實不便宜，但這絕對是人生必來清單之一的地方。不同季節來會看到完全不同的九寨——秋天楓紅、冬天雪景、春天嫩綠、夏天藍得不像話，真的值得四季都來一次。 飲食和商店比較普通，建議自己帶點水和乾糧。唯一需要注意的是天氣，陰天也漂亮，但陽光下的九寨才是極致驚艷。如果你只打算來一次，那就挑個好天氣，然後準備好被美景震撼到不想說話。
Cảnh đẹp đỉnh cao vào mùa thu, người đi xem đông, nên đi bus VIP nếu có điều kiện.

九寨溝風景名勝區，簡稱九寨溝，因溝中有九個藏族村寨而得名。1992年被列為世界自然遺產。處在青藏高原的九寨溝，由「丫」字形分布的日則溝、則查窪溝、樹正溝三條溝谷所構成，景觀分布則在樹正、諾日朗、劍岩、長海、扎如、天海六大景區，九寨溝以其清澈的湖泊、壯觀的瀑布、茂密的森林和獨特的喀斯特地貌而聞名，被稱為「人間仙境」和「童話世界」。人稱「黃山歸來不看山，九寨歸來不看水」，可見九寨溝風景之優美，壯麗的風景有時很難用照片或影像呈現！有機會一定要親自來看看！

這裡是高原，海拔最低也有2000米，請注意你的身體狀況。 交通十分不方便，無論是搭乘飛機還是高鐵，都需要再轉乘數小時的大巴，請提前合理規劃你的行程。 目前九寨溝景區的最後入園時間是下午14點，最後出園時間是下午18點，請提前合理規劃你的行程。 記住門票是一日內有效，景區內很大，走馬觀花的玩一天也很難全逛完，想多玩幾天的話推薦住在風景區內，荷葉寨或者樹正寨裡找一間民宿就好，環境一般都還不錯，貴有貴的道理。還是那句話，請提前合理規劃你的行程。 風景不必贅述，可稱為大自然的瑰寶，即便在2017年大地震之後仍然十分美麗。

10/25在南京機場遇到不好的經驗 機場沒有賣網路流量 去到翠屏山站的商場，中國移動不給外國人辦 我也是傻眼 下到成都入住的飯店，房間空調吹出來都是菸味，最後竟然拿噴霧劑當空氣清淨機 只能說服務真要再加強 10/26一早4：30就起來，一台小巴擠了13人加行李 然後換上一台大巴，開了八個小時山路，路上導遊一直強調高反，買了抗高藥，吃了感覺也還好，就是比較喘，我因為是拿台胞證，不能刷卡片進站，結果我等到3點才拿到票，排隊排到4點才到索道口，我怕趕不上就沒搭了，我們隨團導遊竟沒有跟我們走，最後回去坐車還走了2K才到停車地方 10/27今日九寨溝非常美麗，人很多，我想體驗大自然就用走的下來到犀牛海，路上還下了點雨，接著我走到飯店，腳蠻酸的，買了棗子橘子各10元，蠻多吃不完，因為冷，這邊晚上沒有熱水喝，要自己燒，晚上也不好睡，腳比腳疼，用吹風機吹了好點 10/28早上購物行程，玉石跟牛黃丸蟲草，玉石買了台幣11000多，算是支持一下藏族吧，下午是買犛牛角梳子，晚上是住金立方大飯店 還有這邊司機真的素質低，動不動就喇鈸狂按，沒有考慮別人，好像自己是對的 我走在人行道竟然有電瓶車吧我，說我擋著他了，就算我擋著他，你也可以從旁邊過馬 開車不打燈，急煞急停，我最大 還有你在外面抽菸抽得臭就算了，我把菸點著直接在裡面抽，也沒人管，真是奇特 說一下九寨溝的感覺吧 很多人問訂團好還是自助好 我是在臉書廣告看的九寨溝旅遊，覺得蠻便宜，人均才1680人民幣，如果是想住單間加600，不過不要看行程上只帶你去景點，沒有購物，實際上導遊還是會帶你去買當地的東西，像是玉石，銀飾單價較高，大約都要台幣1萬，要小心這個套路，我這三天玩黃龍，九寨，原本早上要去看川主寺羌城，結果導遊改說看藏族家庭生活，文化，身上的銀腰帶多好用，用了女人都沒婦科病，身上毒素也都被吸走，皮膚更是一點都沒法令紋，為了刺激當地的民生，接著就被帶到銀器專賣的地方，一對一跟你銷售，我看最低的就要2650人民幣，銀飾更貴，記得沒錯也要3000多，不過我的玉石之後導遊會幫你拿給高僧加持，這個大家注意 10月29日去娥眉山，這個景點吃天氣，今天山下陰雨，山上大濃霧一片白，金頂就是最高，很莊嚴，雲海也看不到，蠻多長輩去朝拜，晚上大家吃飯聊天，聊到這三天行程竟一模一樣，連導遊說的話，購物內容，都是完美複制貼上，讓我真的懷疑我買的玉石到底是真是假，就算是假，我身為台灣人我也幫了藏族一次，不後悔 10月30日去樂山大佛，竟然早上又跑了三個購物點，其中兩個是翡翠，我也是服了這，這些人非常煩，不買就一直介紹，是好聲好氣的講，沒有一點不悅的感覺，下午終於去看了大佛及道家三清古廟，樂山跟娥眉我感覺都十分商業化，不過佛像雄偉莊嚴還是體現的出來，有這麼點旅遊成就感，我真的要抱怨抽菸在室內，在中國非常普遍，真的，金立方九店在這住兩晚，一開冷氣，濃厚二手煙撲面而來，更不用說室外了，人手一支，騎電瓶車闖紅燈，人行道騎電瓶車鑽來鑽去，開車的不打燈，我去廣東也是這樣
我是2月的时候去的，是淡季。 😍淡季的九寨沟虽说不是它最美的时候，但是胜在人少，我去的时候每天只有8-9k个游客（旺季最多每天可以接待4万个），体验感真的很好； 🥹去之前觉得交通实在是好折腾，去之后决定春夏秋都要分别再去一次，它太美太值得了！两旁连绵的群山与深林，散落在其中的湖泊瀑布与溪水，无不叫人心旷神怡～

英文评价： China's most famous natural scenery, the pinnacle destination for viewing water, highly recommended to visit. The scenic area is also well-operated: the toilets are clean, there is hot water for handwashing, and there's hardly any wait for the shuttle buses. 中文评价： 中国最著名的自然风光，看水的天花板景区，非常推荐过来，景区运营的也很好，厕所干净，有热水洗手，区间车基本不需要等。

九寨溝位於四川省阿垻藏族羌族自治州(藏族為中國第九大民族；羌族為第二十八大民族)，因有九個藏族村寨而得名，以高山湖泊群和瀑布群為主要特點，擁有原始自然美，變幻無窮的四季景觀，如調色盤般炫麗色澤，同一水域呈現出鵝黃、墨綠、深藍、藏青等，在日光的照映下，斑駁迷離，十分奇妙，可說是水景界的天花板，無怪讚譽為「九寨歸來不看水」。 主要由岷山山脈中呈「丫」字形分布的日則溝(位於丫字右上方)、則查窪溝(位於丫字左上方)、樹正溝(位於丫字下方；即最接近景區大門入口)三條溝谷所構成，海拔在2000公尺至3100公尺之間，屬世界高寒喀斯特地貌。 景區較著名湖泊包括：五花海(冬天唯一不結冰的湖)、蘆葦海、犀牛海、老虎海、五彩池及長海(藏族稱呼湖泊為海、海子或措)。瀑布則有：珍珠灘瀑布、樹正瀑布、諾日朗瀑布。 由於風景區處海拔3000公尺的地區，不宜劇烈運動，以防止高山症，但一般人即便未服用藥物，也不會出現明顯的高山反應。但因海拔高，相對紫外線也較强，建議佩戴太陽眼鏡，並塗抹防曬油以保護皮膚，另除非腿力特差或無自信者，一般遊客是無需登山杖助行。

มาช่วงปลายเดือน พย. อากาศหนาว พื้นลื่นมาก ถ้าพาผู้ใหญ่มาหารองเท้าที่เดินบน น้ำแข็งได้มาด้วยไม่งั้นจะลื่น สถานที่สวยมาก มีจุดที่เดินเยอะโดยเฉพาะทะเลสาบห้าสีที่เดินไกลอยู่ ทะเลสาบอื่นๆก็สวยหมดโดยเฉพาะทะเลสาบนกยูง ถ้ามาช้ากว่าเดือนนี้อาจจะหนาวเกินไปเพราะช่วงนี้ก็ถือว่าหนาวมากแล้วโดยเฉพาะตอนกลางคืน

Khu thắng cảnh Jiuzhaigou tuyệt đẹp . Cửu Trại Câu, có nghĩa là "Thung lũng chín làng") là khu bảo tồn thiên nhiên, vườn quốc gia thuộc châu tự trị dân tộc Khương, dân tộc Tạng A Bá, phía bắc tỉnh Tứ Xuyên, Trung Quốc. Là một thung lũng dài chạy từ bắc xuống nam, Cửu Trại Câu được UNESCO công nhận là Di sản thế giới vào năm 1992, khu dự trữ sinh quyển thế giới năm 1997. Nó được xếp là Cảnh quan được bảo vệ (Loại V) trong hệ thống phân loại khu thực sự tuyệt đẹp rất nhiều hồ nước trong xanh.

九寨沟还是值得跋山涉水来一趟的，年底高铁通车之后应该会更便利。现在从成都坐一天车来一趟实在折腾，直接把娃整高反了，折腾了半个晚上，最后还是坚持陪我走了两个湖，也是不容易。 景区设计很好，设计完备，全线大巴充足。本来打算放弃的我们下午2点多进的景区，坐大巴也基本看完了。走了一下五花海和珍珠滩，全程观光栈道修得很好。最后长海一线的大巴司机和导游更是保姆级导游，让我们迅速打开原车返回，捡漏打卡五彩湖。一天走马观花，两天可以玩得比较细，三天徒步也不是不可以。 哪怕看过国王湖和号称欧洲九寨沟的克罗地亚国家公园，还是觉得九寨沟是很值得来一趟的，大自然的鬼斧神工，独一无二地给了这片神奇的土地。九寨沟最美的应该是秋天吧，希望有缘分这个季节再来。相当推荐👍

เป็นทริปการเดินทางระหว่างวันที่ 21-25 ตุลาคม 2562 ที่ผ่านมานี่เองค่ะ ถือว่าประทับใจมากๆเลยล่ะค่ะ โดยเฉพาความงดงามของธรรมชาติท่ามกลางขุนเขา ใบไม้เปลี่ยนสี ท้องฟ้าเป็นสีฟ้า ผืนน้ำเป็นสีฟ้าเทอควอยส์และเขียวมรกต แถมอากาศบริสุทธิ์ สดชื่น มาก ต้องขอชื่นชมทางเจ้าหน้าที่และผู้ดูแลมรดกโลกจิ่วจ้ายโกวได้ดีมาก แม้ก่อนนี้เคยประสบภัยพิบัติธรรมชาติมาแล้วก็ตาม แต่สามารถพลิกฟื้นคืนธรรมชาติให้กลับมางดงามได้อย่างเยี่ยมยอดอีกครั้ง ไม่ผิดหวังที่มาเยือนค่ะ สำหรับข้อแนะนำจากประสบการณ์ตรงในการเดินทางมาท่องเที่ยวยังจิ่วจ้ายโกวนะคะ ความสมบูรณ์พร้อมของร่างกายที่แข็งแรงถือว่าสำคัญมาก นอกจากจะต้องเดินเท้าระยะทางไกลในแต่ละจุด การขึ้น-ลง รถบัส ท่ามกลางผู้คนจำนวนมาก อาจไม่ง่ายนัก ผู้สูงอายุ เด็ก หรือผู้ที่จำเป็นต้องใช้วีลแชร์ อาจต้องเตรียมการในส่วนนี้ค่ะ(***ได้ถ่ายภาพพร้อมคลิปวิดีโอมาพร้อมการรีวิวในครั้งนี้ด้วยค่ะ***เพื่อประโยชน์แด่ท่านที่ใช้วีลแชร์,ไม้เท้า หรือต้องมีผู้พยุงเดิน)ทั้งนี้ การเดินทางภายในหุบเขาจิ่วจ้ายโกว จะมีรถบัสวน บริการฟรีตามจุดท่องเที่ยวสำคัญๆแก่นักท่องเที่ยวค่ะ และหากท่านได้เดินทางเป็นคณะหรือครอบครัวขนาดใหญ่ สามารถจองรถบัสของอุทยานฯเพื่อใช้ส่วนตัวสำหรับคณะหรือครอบครัวของท่านได้ แต่ในส่วนนี้มีค่าใช้จ่ายและต้องจองรถบัสล่วงหน้านะคะ เนื่องด้วยมีผู้ใช้บริการจำนวนมากค่ะ ในส่วนอาหารการกิน และน้ำดื่ม ขอแนะนำให้พกติดตัวใส่กระเป๋าไปด้วยนะคะ เพราะระหว่างทางเดินตามจุดท่องเที่ยวสำคัญๆจะไม่มีจุดจำหน่ายอาหารหรือน้ำดื่มค่ะ จะมีเพียงจุดใหญ่จุดเดียวคือ ร้านอาหารบุฟเฟต์ของอุทยานฯใกล้ๆ Long Lake ค่ะ สำหรับห้องน้ำ มีทั้งส้วมซึมและชักโครก ค่อนข้างสะอาดค่ะ ในส่วนกระดาษชำระต้องพกติดตัวมาเองนะคะ ทางอุทยานฯไม่มีบริการฟรีในส่วนนี้นะคะ ทั้งนี้ ท่านใดมีโอกาสอยากให้ลองไปเยือนจิ่วจ้ายโกวสักครั้งนะคะ สวยจริงๆ เกินบรรยายอย่างที่ตาเห็นได้จริงๆค่ะ

À lạnh lắm, mình đi vào mùa hè nhưng nhiệt độ ở Cửu Trại Câu là tầm 7-8 độ C. Vào mùa đông có thể xuống âm độ, nên chuẩn bị cái áo khoác nào ấm ấm xíu.

2006年1月9日より4泊5日で冬の九寨溝観光をした時の体験記述です｡ 成都より空路で九寨黄龍空港へ 到着後 空港より宿泊先の 九寨溝シェラトンホテルにチェックインしました 高山病対策でガイドの勧めです｡ 翌日から2日間九寨溝をガイドの案内でくまなく周りました｡ 最奥部の湖は全面が凍り真っ白になっておりました 五彩池の周囲には雪が残っており 上から見るのエメラルドグルーン の水の色が綺麗です｡ 珍珠灘瀑布は殆どが凍り真っ白な姿を 見せ底部には色々な形をした氷柱が立っておりました｡ 鏡海では風が無く山の稜線,濃淡とブルーの空が湖面に鏡のように映り凄く綺麗でした｡ 熊猫海の湖面も色合いが素晴らしかったです｡ 冬季で観光客も少なくレストランも一軒しか開いていなく 土産物ショップ等はは全てクローズでした。初日は入り口より奥部を散策し 二日目は入り口方面に向かって 樹正瀑布,火花海,盆景灘等を 見て回りました 林の中の水路には飛沫で出来た ツララが枝に付着して 見事な造形美が見れました｡ 冬の九寨溝は 景色も良く 観光客も 少なくゆっくりと散策ができます お勧めです｡

2011年我在九寨溝。九寨溝，以有九個藏族村寨而得名, 處在青藏高原東南的尕爾納山峰北麓，主要由岷山山脈中呈「丫」字形分布的日則溝、則查窪溝、樹正溝三條溝谷所構成，海拔在2000米至3106米之間，屬世界高寒喀斯特地貌。總面積約620km²，約有52%的面積被原始森林所覆蓋，期間夾生箭竹和各種奇花異草，也有諸多野生動物棲息於此，如大熊貓、金絲猴、白唇鹿等。 1992年被列為世界自然遺產，保留大量第四紀古冰川冰川遺蹟，而來自雪山活水本身清澈，加之梯狀湖泊層層過濾，其水色顯得更加透明，像是大片灑落在大地的藍寶石，因其清澈而能倒映青山白雲加上水藍的水，構成了迷人如童話故事的景色。 2017年8月8日深夜於景區內發生大地震，多個景點產生崩塌，見證了滄海桑田。

九寨沟是中国最美的风景区之一，由日则沟、则查洼沟、树正沟呈“Y”字形的山谷构成，山谷间夹有100多个大大小小的湖泊，山林湖泊之间有形态各异的悬瀑。雪山、森林、瀑布、湖泊、野花等等呈现出美仑美奂的“人间仙境”、“童话世界”。 “九寨沟”据说是因为几个沟谷内分布有9座藏族山寨而得名。 曾经两次在秋末初冬来到“九寨沟”，乘电瓶车或徒步其间，印象最为深刻的是气势雄伟、飞流而下的诺日朗瀑布；水流激荡、浪花千叠的珍珠滩瀑布，经典的86版《西游记》片尾师徒四人牵马西行的画面就是在此取景；湖水如镜、色彩斑斓的五彩池。张艺谋的电影《英雄》更有多个场景在九寨沟内完成。 冬日的“九寨沟”瀑布挂着晶莹的冰柱，倒影湖中的雪山、翠树令水面泛着清冷的幽静，一丛丛挂着红色果实或赤褐叶子的高树、低木让眼前的色彩更加靓丽。 经过大地震之后的九寨沟今年3月8日重新开放，希望仙境般的翠海、山林、湖泊、飞瀑等都一如过往的美丽。 提醒：目前九寨沟仅开放团队旅游。 景区门票旺季（4月1日至11月15日）110元/张 淡季（3月8日至3月31日、11月16日至12月31日）40元/张。 观光车票90元/张（不分淡旺季）。

九寨溝風景名勝區位在四川省阿壩藏族羌族自治州九寨溝縣(原南坪縣)，有「童話世界」的美譽，因圍繞的山區內有九個藏族村寨，因此得名─九寨溝。九寨溝為自然保護區，也是國家級風景名勝區，最高海拔約在4800公尺，九寨溝最高海拔約在4800公尺，區內有湖泊、瀑布、雪山和森林，景色殊異，自然天成，尤其在秋天來臨時，葉色隨著變，林相更是繽紛多彩，五顏六色美不勝收。更被列入世界人類自然遺產名錄。 九寨溝的高峰、彩林、翠海、疊瀑和藏族風情被稱為五絕。以三溝318海最為代表，其中包含有五灘十二瀑，十流數十泉為主景觀。九寨溝以原始的生態環境，一塵不染的清新空氣和雪山、森林、湖泊组合成神妙、奇幻、幽美的自然風光，呈現自然的美，美的自然。九寨溝的水更是九寨溝的靈魂，因清純潔淨、晶瑩剔透故有九寨溝歸來不看水之說。除外，九寨溝的動植物資源也非常豐富，原始森林遍布，棲息着大熊猫等珍貴野生動物。 九寨溝風景名勝區景觀主要以Ｙ型的樹正溝、日則溝、則查窪溝等3條主溝所組成，全長長達50多公里。其中樹正溝景區長75公里，有盆景灘、樹正群海、樹正瀑布、双龍海、火花海、卧龍海等景點組成，也是三條風景區中最有看頭的；日則溝景區，有諾日朗、珍珠灘、高瀑布三大瀑布，有鏡海、熊猫海、芳草海、天鵝海、劍岩、原始森林、戀泉、五花海等景點；則查窪溝景區，有長75公里的長海和五彩池等景點。 九寨溝風景名勝區四季景色都十分迷人；其中以九寨的冬天最為熱門，沒有天寒地凍，只有深深感動！冬季的九寨溝，素裹銀裝的山巒、變幻冰晶的的湖泊，在日出日落的映照下充滿詩情畫意，營造出一個晶瑩剔透的『童話世界』。最具代表九寨冰雪世界的是絢爛冰瀑，諾日朗、熊貓海、珍珠灘、樹正瀑布等無一例外都成了冰雕藝術，如時間凍止般形成的各種形態之冰雕，正等待著您的想像，來賦予其生命。 2002年四川省政府提出「國際大九寨世界旅遊區」的概念，以九寨溝、黃龍景區為主，以整合阿壩州豐富的自然生態和歷史文化資源為重點，積極打造一個稱為「九寨天堂」的全方位型度假生態旅遊區，引導旅客觀光旅遊、休閒度假。 九寨天堂的面積比九寨溝還要大上好幾十倍，它包括了阿壩藏族羌族自治州的九寨溝縣和若爾蓋縣，景區內涵蓋了九寨溝、甘海子、黃龍景區、神仙池、臥龍大熊貓基地、四姑娘山、達古冰川、九曲黃河第一彎、若爾蓋大草原等自然景觀，和桃坪羌寨、卓克基官寨、紅軍長征紀念園等，單單是它的核心面積就大的驚人，達3.2萬平方公里，相當於50個新加坡大。 四川省的九寨溝是一個充滿夢幻與詩意的童話國度，更是大自然造化賜予人類最美麗的樂土，更是自助旅遊家的最佳首選旅遊目的地。

Jiuzhaigou; Chinese: 九寨沟;（pinyin: Jiǔ zhài gōu) is a nature reserve and national park located in the north of Sichuan Province in the southwestern region of China. A long valley running north to south, Jiu zhai gou was inscribed by UNESCO as a World Heritage Site in 1992 and a World Biosphere Reserve in 1997.It belongs to the category V (Protected Landscape) in the IUCN system of protected area categorization. 九寨溝風景名勝區，簡稱九寨溝，位於中國四川省北部阿壩藏族羌族自治州九寨溝縣（原南坪縣）因溝中有樹正、荷葉、則查窪、盤信、黑果、盤亞助、故窪、彭布、尖盤九個藏族村寨而得名。九寨溝水系流經白河、白水江、嘉陵江，最後流入長江。1992年被列為世界自然遺產。九寨溝大多數湖泊的形成源於水中所含碳酸鈣。遠古時代，地球處於冰期時，水中所含碳酸鈣質無法凝結，只能隨水漂流。到距今約12000年前，氣候轉暖後流水中的碳酸鈣質活躍起來，一旦遇到障礙物便附著其上，逐漸積累，形成今天九寨溝中一條條乳白色的鈣質堤埂，這些堤埂堆積起來形成堰塞湖。

九寨溝位於中國四川省的北部。它是一個海拔很高的地方，地方天然景色確實很美麗，但離成都市也很遠，聽當地居民說坐汽車到成都大概要10個小時的車程。(以下就分享旅遊九寨溝的經歷) 第一天(6月5號，到達九寨溝) 因當天坐下午兩點的飛機，大概三點半就到了九寨溝黃龍機場，一下到飛機感覺有點涼涼的當去拿行李的時候就整個人自然而然地顫抖起來了，感覺非常冷，然後查一下當地天氣：是9°,心想這是夏天的天氣嗎？機場周圍的工作人員都是穿厚厚的外套，我們是短袖、涼鞋>.< >.< 。不管了，然後去買機場汽車票，(機場包車50人民幣/人，大概一車有12人，)票上有寫汽車車牌號，需要自己去找這汽車停在哪，然後上車。我們訂的旅館在天堂口(距離九寨溝1公里),由機場到鎮那邊大概要開兩個半小時的車。在搭車的路途風景很美，綠茵茵的樹木，連綿不斷的高山，山頂還披著一層雪(夏天還能看到雪山！！！)搭車不久，身體慢慢感覺胸口發悶，呼吸不順暢，頭暈，這不是暈車，是高原反應！！因為機場算是在高海拔的地方，所以這一路車程是下山，然後一路都耳鳴，需要一路喝水和咽口水。終於到了鎮上的汽車站，需要自行再乘車去自己住的旅館(機場司機的小提示：要我們下車後不要乘搭私家車，因為一開始講好的價錢到最後會不同，最好搭的士，他們會打表算錢。)所以我們就跟一個女孩拼搭一架的士走。十多分鐘就到天堂口，找到旅館加放下東西那時候已經快晚上七點了。然後我們就在天堂口裏面的美食街隨便找了一家飯館吃飯，很幸運，天堂口是鎮上最熱鬧的一個地方，周圍有便利店，服裝店，飯店，非常方便。在美食街裏嘗了酥油茶(個人感覺一般，感覺像喝油一樣)，買了手信：全都與牛有關的(其實這裡的手信店的東西貴，到處有得賣)，吃完飯，就趕緊去藥店買高原藥：紅景天。然後在街邊逛當地居民擺的小攤檔。 第二天(6月6號，遊覽九寨溝) 因為高原反應，感覺很困、很累，第二天起來差不多十點，結果由十一點出發遊覽九寨溝(其實應該9點出發，才有充分時間遊覽整個九寨溝)。由天堂口去九寨溝溝口搭的士不用5分鐘就到(這的士沒打表，收我們15塊錢！！原來可以慢慢走路到溝口很快到15-20 mins)。進去九寨溝要買門票，成人310元，出示學生證有半價優惠，票價包括在九寨溝裏面的車費，在溝裏可以任意搭。首先進 入九寨溝後，就搭巴士去山頂，一路遊覽下來，一路都可以搭到車(門口會有很多人問要不要導遊的需要，司機告訴我們其實不需要導遊帶，可以自己遊覽的)。遊覽路線有兩條，一條是去山頂看長海，五彩池那邊，另一條是去原始森林為終點(需要一天時間遊覽整個九寨溝)。建議每個景點最多停留20分鐘，因為到最後可能會看不完就要走了(九寨溝6點關門)，每個景點都相距一定的距離，有一些需要搭車到下一個景點，有一些則需要走十分鐘路程，每個景點都是在海拔兩千以上，有高原反應的，走樓梯都會感覺很困難(建議進溝前吃高原藥)。個人建議：去原始森林的路線時，可以選擇不到山頂，因為沒東西看，單單是高山連綿，可以在半路下車，一路看下去，有時間的可以在天鵝海下車，沒時間的可以在五花海下車(他們溝內巴士服務大概在4點停止上原始森林，然後巴士們一路掃客下山)。在遊覽九寨溝期間，裏面沒什麼吃的地方，偶爾有小食店，買的東西貴一兩倍不止(介意價錢的建議帶些乾糧進去)。一天九寨溝的遊覽，會有很大的收穫：很多美翻天的景色，讓你大開眼界，還有疲倦、饑餓的身軀。 遊覽九寨溝的小提示： 1.帶冬天衣服，因為夏天也只有幾度的溫度 2.如有高原反應，自先買好高原藥 3.在九寨溝買東西可以講價，通常他們開高價砍遊客 4.個人自由行的，出去遊覽景點可以吃飽再帶備乾糧，地方太原始，餐館不容易找

九寨溝は全長約30㎞にもなるY字谷の渓谷で、北の入口から南に延びる渓谷は「樹正溝」、途中で二股に分岐し、西の渓谷は「日則溝」、東の渓谷は「則査窪溝」である。九寨溝内を運行しているシャトルバスでそれぞれの渓谷を巡ることになるが、渓谷ごとにビューポイントを繋ぐ遊歩道があり、バスを降りて歩きながら美しい湖や海子(池)、滝を見て回る。世界遺産の景勝地なので観光客で混雑している。大概は人混みの頭越しに景色を見られれば良いくらいだそうだ。比較的空いている渓谷を優先して巡ってしまうのが効率的かもしれないかもしれない。 日則溝の五花海と珍珠灘瀑布、則査窪溝の五彩池は絶対に必見。 九寨溝（黄龍も）の木道は、細い木材を並べて桟状にしたようなもので、一応滑りにくい木道と言える。ところが雨が降ったり渓谷の水しぶきで濡れていると、けっこう滑りやすい。平坦なら問題ないが、傾斜がある歩道や階段を下るときたまにヒヤッとさせられた。階段で滑り転倒し数段滑り落ちた男性を、目の前で目撃した。このタイプの木道に掛け替えてから10年あるいは数年経過しているようだし、摩耗が進んでいるせいかもしれない。また階段を下るときに、桟が横縞なので段差が非常に見えにくい。ステップに段差目印となる黄色のペンキが塗ってあることもあるが、ほとんどが剥げてしまっている。かえって足元に目を落とすと、段差が見えないため踏み外しそうで怖くなった。中国人観光客の特に女性は運動靴ではない人も多いが、やはり滑りにくい靴底の靴が絶対におすすめ。

Độ cao của Cửu Trại Câu dao động từ 2.000 cho đến 4.500 mét (6.600 đến 14.800 ft) so với mực nước biển. Năm 1990, khu phong cảnh này được đánh giá là một trong 40 khu du lịch đẹp nhất của Trung Quốc. Năm 1997, khu phong cảnh Cửu Trại Câu được phân loại V trong hệ thống phân loại khu vực bảo vệ của IUCN.

Jiuzhaigou (kitajsko: 九寨沟, pinjin – Jiǔzhàigōu, tibetansko: གཟི་རྩ་སྡེ་དགུ།), dobesedno tudi Dolina devetih vasi, je naravni rezervat in narodni park v južnem delu gorovja Min Shan, ki se nahaja na severu province Sečuan, v okrožjuNanping. Zajema okoli 720 km2 površine. Na jugu meji na Huanglong, ki je prav tako zaščiteno območje, vendar neposredni prestop ni možen, zato mora obiskovalec narediti približno 120 km ovinek. Tako kot Huanglong so tudi dolino Jiuzhaigou dolga leta poznali samo domačini. Leta 1978 je kitajska vlada sprejela prve zaščitne ukrepe in prepovedala sečnjo gozdov. Dandanes dolino obišče preko 10.000 obiskovalcev na dan. UNESCO je dolino razglasil za svetovno naravno dediščino leta 1992. Pokrajino dejansko oblikujejo tri doline, in sicer višje ležeči dolini Rize (kitajsko: 日则沟, pinjin: Rìzé Gōu) in Zechawa (kitajsko: 则查洼沟, pinjin: Zécháwā Gōu), ki tečeta iz juga in se združujeta v dolino Shuzheng (kitajsko: 树正沟, pinjin: Shùzhèng Gōu), kar daje obliko črke Y. Doline se iz nadmorske višine postopno vzpenjajo iz 2.000 m na ustju doline Shuzheng do preko 4.700 m na vrhu doline Zechawa, na gori Ganzigonggai. Skozi območje potekajo številne prelomnice, ki so nastale zaradi trka Evrazijske plošče s ploščo Yangtze; potresi so tako v veliki meri oblikovali okolico. Površje Jiuzhaigouja tvori povečini apnenec, zaradi katerega so ob delovanju ledenikov in vodovja nastali številni kraški pojavi. Najvidnejše znamenitosti Jiuzhaigouja so njegova številna kristalno čista ledeniška jezera, ki so zaradi apnenca obarvana v modrih, zelenih in turkiznih odtenkih.
